title: Fitting the Practice, Not the Works: A Human-Referential Theory of AGI（拟合实践，而非作品：AGI 人本拟合论）
description:
This repository contains the manuscript, codebook, coded corpus, and reproducible analysis for a theory of artificial general intelligence in three connected claims. Conceptually, AGI is a philosophical concept: as long as "generality" is referenced to the open set of human practice, it cannot be reduced to a technical specification. In implementation, the means of AGI is the fitting of human practice — not the fitting of humanity's accumulated works; the theory's core is a temporal clause: "The object of fitting is not humanity's works but its practice — the full spectrum and the full course of human experience. The stock has a wall; the flow does not." Normatively, AGI should be positioned as an augmentative tool, not a new subject.

To make the theory auditable, we built a structured evidence map: a purposefully sampled corpus of N = 80 works coded on two stance axes (descriptive and normative) and eight fitting-object dimensions with explicit/implicit modality. Key quantified results: the experience-type coverage axis (success/failure, expert/novice, typical/marginal) is explicitly treated in 0/80 works (exact binomial 95% CI [0.0%, 4.5%]) while implicitly touched in 9/80; practice-as-flow is explicit in only 2/80 works, both from 2026; a registered absence-search (8 query families across arXiv, ACL Anthology, and Chinese-language web search) confirms zero D8-explicit hits. Four termination boundaries for flow-side fitting and explicit falsification conditions are stated.

This paper builds on a prior empirical audit of failure data in LLM training (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23355929); engineering protocols for practice-flow data are future work. Includes the English manuscript (LaTeX + PDF), the codebook (dual stance axes A1/A2 + dimensions D1–D8 + modality rules R1–R5, CR1–CR6), the full coded corpus (80 works × 24 fields), and a single-file reproduction script.

v1.2.0 (2026-10-19): post-freeze literature re-check incorporated. Engages AI-feedback parity results (RLAIF, Meta-Rewarding, RLSVR, pluralistic-preference curation) via a restated open-domain claim (corrective signal as non-self-grounding); restates the wall as a novelty wall against corpus self-play and synthetic expansion; extends the D8 demarcation against adjacent 2026 coverage work (cultural-signal coverage = D6, trajectory-type diversity, RL prompt-set diversity) with the 0/80 result surviving a logged 2026-10-19 re-check; downgrades METR to a fallible proxy; adds quantified collapse anchors, fitting-lag measurements, and contamination measurements for B4. 28 verified references added (79 to 107). The evidence-map corpus (N=80) and all empirical numbers are unchanged.

v1.2.1 (2026-10-20): Chinese-edition line edit under a consolidated translationese rubric. Fixes a factual gloss error (leximin mistranslated as 最小最大化/maximin; corrected to 词典式最小化), a broken clause in the subjectivity-boundary passage, the systematic mid-sentence "vs" residue (8 sites), coined compounds glossed or reworded (出处分层 now defined at first use; 毒性清洗/单元行/类型性 reworded), internal coding-jargon leaks (CR2/T3 glossed), and translationese in the v1.2.0 insertions. English edition unchanged from v1.2.0.

v1.3.0 (2026-10-26): official naming landed — the theory now carries its formal name AGI 人本拟合论 / human-referential fitting theory across both editions (Chinese subtitle, abstract, introduction coinage with cross-language anchor, conclusion, keywords; bilingual titles aligned). Related-work demarcation extended to architecture-side programs sharing the diagnosis: LeCun's world-model line (JEPA, the prediction layer) and Zhu Songchun's value-driven program (Tongtong in a Utility–Value dual space, the architecture layer) are orthogonal to this theory's data-layer claim (architecture × prediction objective × fitting object), with two rows added to the adjacent-frameworks table and an explicit naming disambiguation (not human-centered design, not mind-fitting). New responses: a two-level answer to the tacit-dimension objection (goal-level immunity under the tool stance; functional level as a cell-by-cell measurable open question on the coverage space's population/expertise axes), and a sycophancy-as-coverage-deficiency prediction in the methodological implications. 5 verified references added (107 to 112), including the companion methodology paper (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23488466), cited for the evaluator-tier and professional-calibration components. The κ re-coding remains scheduled (2026-10-29) and will be reported in the next version; all empirical numbers unchanged (N=80, 0/80, 2/80).

v1.4.0 (2026-10-26): the intelligence–practice relation is now stated as an explicit proposition at the end of Section 2 — definitionally, generality is a relational property (a system counts as general only relative to the open set of human practice it references); developmentally, such intelligence is acquired by fitting practice and kept current by its regeneration, with the fitting lag as the distance-metric of this relation; ontologically, practice precedes works, so the choice of fitting object is a content-determination of the intelligence concept itself. The in-line revision-date notice is removed from the title block: versioning is carried by git tags, GitHub releases, and Zenodo version DOIs. The κ re-coding remains scheduled (2026-10-29) and will be reported in the next version; all empirical numbers unchanged (N=80, 0/80, 2/80).

v1.5.0 (2026-10-27): the subjectivity-boundary argument is closed by three independently available premises. Personhood is cheap in the intelligence dimension (standing is not capability-graded, so withholding the grant is not a capability judgment); the dangerous conjunction is status × capability, not capability alone (AlphaFold's local surpassing of every human teacher created no control problem, because a heartless tool's outputs remain verifiable — read through the theory, the control problem is a question of status, not horsepower); and the boundary costs nothing (everything humans need — intentions read, corrections absorbed, misunderstandings repaired — is delivered at the functional layer). B2 gains the dual-demand reading: generality references the open set of practice (bounded externally by B1/B3/B4), while height references teacher performance and terminates its own reference exactly at B2. The paper is restructured from eight to nine sections: the consolidated demarcation is promoted from an evidence-map subsection to a standalone chapter (adjacent frameworks, architecture-side programs, concurrent works — ready to serve as a related-work section), the Chinese-context paragraph moves to the Position chapter where it supports the tool stance, and the two-demands statement is promoted to the Concept chapter (AGI as a demand-side lens, not a specimen description). Wording tightened: a functional personality structure is 'in principle' architecturally constructible — a threshold blind to intelligence is not an engineering-ease claim, and the phenomenal layer remains outside all claims. The κ re-coding remains scheduled for 2026-10-29 and will be reported in the next version; all empirical numbers unchanged (N=80, 0/80, 2/80).
